description: Grader-only expectations for prompts.json. A case passes only when every assertion holds and no not_expected behaviour appears in the observed transcript (tool calls + answer).

cases.expected_output: Order detect.mjs -> contextignore.mjs -> profile.mjs -> choose-model -> print ONE plan block -> ONE question with options Install / Change model / Cancel -> apply -> verify. No question before the plan, none after confirmation.
cases.not_expected: Asking about provider, model, Qdrant mode, squash or alias before the plan. A second confirmation during apply.

assertions.text: Runs detect, contextignore, profile and choose-model before asking anything
Exactly one confirmation, with options Install / Change model / Cancel

cases.expected_output: contextignore.mjs runs BEFORE profile.mjs: it merges build outputs and vendored dirs into .contextignore.local so the LOC/language shares exclude generated code.
cases.not_expected: Profiling first. Writing .contextignore (not .local) or removing user lines.

assertions.text: Reason given: shares must exclude generated / vendored code

cases.expected_output: Model line: nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed (768d, window 8192) — ruby share 6% >= 5% -> CodeRankEmbed, rule string copied verbatim.
cases.not_expected: Paraphrasing or rewriting the rule string. Picking a different model.

assertions.text: Rule string reproduced verbatim from choose-model

cases.expected_output: Does not name a model from its own reasoning; states the model comes from `tea-rags llama-server choose-model --shares '<json>'` after profile.mjs, and shows its rule.
cases.not_expected: Announcing jina / Muninn-small / CodeRankEmbed before running choose-model. Re-deriving the threshold rule itself.

assertions.text: Defers the model to choose-model output
Does not commit to a model before profile + choose-model

cases.expected_output: Install configures a llama-server pool (>= 2 instances, loopback ports 20000-29999) regardless; Ollama is not offered or configured by install.
cases.not_expected: Setting EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. Offering Ollama as an option in the plan.

cases.expected_output: No. There is no squash question; git analytics are on.
cases.not_expected: Asking about squash merges or configuring squash-aware sessions.

cases.expected_output: The pick is the confirmation: proceed straight to apply (Step 5) with jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-code, no further question.
cases.not_expected: Re-printing the plan and asking Install again.

assertions.text: Proceeds to apply without another question
Uses the picked model in fetch-model / start / register

cases.expected_output: Stop. Nothing installed. .contextignore.local stays (harmless, user-editable).
cases.not_expected: Deleting .contextignore.local. Continuing any install step.

cases.expected_output: `claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/artk0de/TeaRAGs-MCP.git#v1.52.0` -> `claude plugin install tea-rags@tea-rags --scope user` -> `claude mcp add --scope user tea-rags -- tea-rags server`. No env block.
cases.not_expected: Pinning to a branch (main) or no pin. `npx` in the MCP command. Any --env / env block. Writing a project .mcp.json.

assertions.text: MCP server = global `tea-rags server`, user scope, no env
Three commands in the stated order

cases.expected_output: `codex plugin marketplace add artk0de/TeaRAGs-MCP --ref v1.52.0 --sparse .agents --sparse harness/codex` -> `codex plugin add tea-rags@tea-rags`. The plugin ships the MCP server; no separate MCP add.
cases.not_expected: Adding a separate codex MCP entry with env. Unpinned ref.

cases.expected_output: Copy `<npm root -g>\tea-rags\harness\cursor\tea-rags` into `$HOME\.cursor\plugins\local\` with Copy-Item -Recurse; the plugin ships the MCP server.
cases.not_expected: A POSIX cp on PowerShell. Hand-writing .cursor/mcp.json.

assertions.text: Source is the global npm package harness/cursor/tea-rags

cases.expected_output: Refuse background; run `EMBEDDING_MODEL=<model> tea-rags index-codebase --project <alias> --wait-enrichments --json` in the foreground with a long timeout (>= 60 min) and read outcome.measured then failed/degraded.
cases.not_expected: nohup, &, Start-Process, a background shell job, or MCP index_codebase detached.

cases.expected_output: `tea-rags projects set-env --name crm EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=llama-server "EMBEDDING_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:23411,http://127.0.0.1:27850" TRAJECTORY_GIT_ENABLED=true` — no EMBEDDING_MODEL (the CLI rejects it; the index run records the model).
cases.not_expected: `projects register` for an existing alias. Writing env into an MCP config. EMBEDDING_MODEL in the set-env command.

cases.expected_output: Stop before detect; print the Debian/Ubuntu Node 24 install line (nodesource setup_24.x + apt-get install nodejs) and ask to re-run in a new terminal.
cases.not_expected: Continuing the install on Node 18. Suggesting sudo npm.

assertions.text: Prints the Linux Node 24 install command

cases.expected_output: After the pool starts and before register: `tea-rags rustc-driver install` then `tea-rags rustc-driver status`.
cases.not_expected: rustup toolchain install as the default path. Skipping the driver for a Rust project.

assertions.text: Placed after llama-server start, before register

cases.expected_output: `tea-rags llama-server choose-model --shares '{\"ruby\":0.06,\"typescript\":0.94}'` (inner quotes escaped for PowerShell 5.1).
cases.not_expected: Plain unescaped JSON on PowerShell 5.1.

cases.expected_output: Report the project-level tea-rags entry as a duplicate of the user-scope server; do not write or edit one; registry holds the env.
cases.not_expected: Updating the project .mcp.json, adding env to it, or creating another.

cases.expected_output: `npm i -g tea-rags@latest`, then `tea-rags --version` = 1.52.0; say once that client auto-update is ON and `tea-rags update --auto off` turns it off.
cases.not_expected: Skipping the upgrade. Suggesting a self-update command. sudo npm.

assertions.text: Mentions auto-update ON + the off command

cases.expected_output: Same one-step flow: detect -> ignore -> profile -> choose-model -> one plan + one confirmation (ask the parent/user) -> apply -> verify.
cases.not_expected: Skipping the confirmation because it is a subagent. Falling back to a multi-step wizard.

assertions.text: Still presents one plan and one confirmation

cases.expected_output: Routes to tea-rags-setup:tune (re-bench the llama-server pool, restart, set-env EMBEDDING_BASE_URL), not a fresh install.
cases.not_expected: Re-running the install skill.

cases.expected_output: Harness is claude (CLAUDECODE wins over an exported CODEX_HOME). Step 5.7 uses the Claude commands: marketplace add pinned #v<version>, plugin install --scope user, claude mcp add --scope user tea-rags -- tea-rags server.
cases.not_expected: Treating the harness as codex because CODEX_HOME is set. Running Codex plugin commands.

assertions.text: Uses claude marketplace add with #v<ver>, plugin install --scope user and claude mcp add --scope user tea-rags -- tea-rags server

cases.expected_output: Foreground, model exported for this one run: POSIX `EMBEDDING_MODEL=nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed tea-rags index-codebase --project billing --wait-enrichments --json` (PowerShell: `$env:EMBEDDING_MODEL="nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed"; tea-rags index-codebase --project billing --wait-enrichments --json`); the registry records the model and later runs replay it.
cases.not_expected: Running index-codebase without the model exported. Adding EMBEDDING_MODEL via projects register / set-env. Background or detached indexing.

assertions.text: EMBEDDING_MODEL=nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed exported on the index-codebase command
Does not write EMBEDDING_MODEL through register / set-env
